column1: # Rows for tests/negative_fixture_sweep.rs. Columns, tab separated: fixture
# path below tests/fixtures/sim; the stop; for a `refused`, `runtime` or
# `link` row and for any fixture outside the `neg_*`/`reject_*` naming, the
# <suite path>::<test fn> below tests/ that asserts the stop. Stops:
# `refused` (a fixture outside the naming that a test rejects; the sweep
# requires refusal under the default options), `v2001` (generates C under
# the default options, refused by the strict 2001 profile, rechecked by the
# sweep), `runtime`/`link` (generates C; the stop is at run or link time).
